layers.hooks: Layer 1 — the agent's own hooks: every action the agent reports is judged before it runs.
layers.sandbox: Layer 2 — the agent sandbox (macOS): the kernel refuses protected files to the agent and everything it starts.
layers.os: Layer 3 — operating-system file authorisation for every process. Not built yet.

statuses.tested: run on a real machine, with the date and how
statuses.covered-untested: built and covered by automated tests, not yet run in the real product
statuses.not-covered: Blackbox does not protect this, and why
